brief.claim: Reaction time depends more strongly on stimulus contrast in the attended condition than in the unattended condition: the regression slope of reaction time on contrast is steeper in the attended condition than in the unattended condition across 30 participants, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: stimulus contrast level shown to each participant
mean reaction time in the attended condition
mean reaction time in the unattended condition, same participants

brief.sizes: 30 participants, each measured in both conditions.
